explanation.text: The estimated resident population of New Zealand at 30 June 2024 was 5,290,000 according to official provisional data from Stats NZ.
Midyear 2024 aligns with the date of 30 June 2024 used in the official population estimate.
Stats NZ provides the base population figure of 5.290 million (provisional) as of 30 June 2024 based on the 2023 Census and Post-enumeration Survey.
Figure.NZ reports the estimated resident population for New Zealand as of June 2024 as 5,290,000, sourced from Statistics New Zealand.
The value 5,290,000 matches the claim of 5,290,000 people living in New Zealand at midyear 2024.
The population estimate is provisional and subject to revision, but is currently the official figure provided by Stats NZ.
